text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Political parties expect to receive final documents underlining President Zeroual's planned reforms ahead of national conference to be convened Sept 11-12. Documents detail drafts of election and party laws and constitutional changes.
- Former prime minister Hamrouche criticises successive presidents for fostering bureaucratic power.

- National conference between opposition political parties and authorities will focus on political platform. Draft election and party laws will likely be submitted by Zeroual to Transitional National Council for vote.
- Three main private business organisations merge into one group. A fourth organisation is considering joining later.
